Discover the benefits of biogas-powered mining

Biogas energy

Biogas is a renewable energy source produced from organic waste through a process called anaerobic digestion. This process generates electricity in an eco-friendly way, significantly reducing the carbon footprint.

Increased profitability

Using biogas-generated electricity allows us to reduce energy costs by up to 80%. This massive reduction in operating expenses directly translates to higher profitability for our mining operations and those who rent our equipment and infrastructure.

Sustainability

By choosing HUSBY, you are supporting an environmentally friendly approach to cryptocurrency mining. Our use of biogas energy not only cuts costs but also promotes sustainable and responsible business practices. Strategic location in Europe.
